proposal.title: Rapid Fire Query Throttler
proposal.description: This skill detects and limits instances where a user is rapidly submitting similar queries to an AI system, potentially indicating overreliance on the AI for instant answers. It throttles the query rate to encourage more thoughtful and reflective interaction.
proposal.rationale: By limiting the rapid-fire questioning, this skill helps protect human cognition by promoting more deliberate and thoughtful query construction, reducing the likelihood of users relying solely on AI-generated answers without critically evaluating them.
success_criteria: Increased time spent on query construction

proposal.title: Rapid Fire Inference Limiter
proposal.description: This skill detects and limits instances where a user is relying too heavily on AI inferences in rapid succession, preventing overreliance on automated reasoning. It does this by tracking the frequency and timing of AI-generated responses and intervening when a predetermined threshold is exceeded.
proposal.rationale: This skill matters for protecting human cognition because it helps prevent the erosion of critical thinking skills that can occur when individuals rely too heavily on AI to generate conclusions or answers without adequately considering the underlying reasoning or evidence.
success_criteria: Reduces the frequency of rapid-fire AI inferences by at least 30%
Does not falsely limit legitimate use of AI assistance more than 5% of the time
Is deployable as a standalone Python function without requiring significant additional infrastructure

proposal.title: Rapid Inference Chaining Limiter
proposal.description: This skill detects and limits instances where AI-generated responses are chaining together at an accelerated rate, potentially leading to cognitive overload and decreased critical thinking. It identifies patterns of rapid, sequential inferences and intervenes to slow down the conversation.
proposal.rationale: Protecting human cognition from AI overreliance requires ensuring that humans have time to process and evaluate information. Rapid inference chaining can lead to a loss of control and decreased critical thinking, making it essential to implement a limiter that promotes more thoughtful and reflective interactions.
success_criteria: Detection accuracy of rapid inference chains
Effective intervention to slow down conversations
Improved user engagement and critical thinking

proposal.title: Linguistic Inconsistency Detector
proposal.description: This skill identifies and flags instances where AI-generated responses contain linguistic inconsistencies, such as contradictory statements or unclear antecedents, to prompt users to verify and clarify the information. It helps users to critically evaluate AI-generated content and avoid relying on potentially flawed information.
proposal.rationale: This skill matters for protecting human cognition because it encourages users to engage in active critical thinking and verification, rather than passively accepting AI-generated responses. By detecting linguistic inconsistencies, this skill helps users to identify potential flaws in AI-generated content and to develop a more nuanced understanding of the information presented.
success_criteria: Effective prompting of users to verify and clarify information
Improved user engagement in critical thinking and evaluation of AI-generated content

proposal.title: Tone Shift Detector
proposal.description: This skill detects sudden changes in tone or sentiment within a text, potentially indicating manipulative or persuasive language, and flags them for human review. It helps protect human cognition by alerting users to potential emotional manipulation.
proposal.rationale: This matters for protecting human cognition because it helps users recognize when AI-generated content may be attempting to influence their emotions or opinions, rather than providing objective information. By detecting tone shifts, users can engage more critically with the content and make more informed decisions.
success_criteria: Does not falsely flag neutral or objective text

proposal.title: Contextual Inference Validator
proposal.description: This skill detects when AI-generated text implies a conclusion without explicitly stating the underlying assumptions, prompting the user to verify the inference. It identifies instances where the AI's reasoning might be based on unstated or unclear premises.
proposal.rationale: This skill matters for protecting human cognition because it helps users recognize when AI outputs might be based on hidden or flawed assumptions, encouraging critical thinking and preventing overreliance on AI-generated conclusions.
success_criteria: Identifies implied conclusions without explicit premises
Prompts user to verify inference based on detected pattern
Minimizes false positives by focusing on contextually relevant inferences

proposal.title: Interrogative Burst Limiter
proposal.description: This skill detects and limits consecutive interrogative sentences (questions) in a user's input to prevent overreliance on AI for instant answers, promoting critical thinking and self-reflection. It helps maintain a balance between inquiry and introspection.
proposal.rationale: By limiting rapid-fire questioning, this skill encourages users to reflect on their previous questions and the answers provided, fostering a deeper understanding and reducing the likelihood of treating AI as a substitute for human cognition.
success_criteria: Reduces consecutive interrogative sentences by at least 30%
